summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #39. Committed: (1) SolverParityCorpusTests replaying the real parity corpus committed verbatim from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (upstream #111 is merged on main; 12 scenarios incl. ties, exclusions, zero-weight and unknown-weight handling) through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer with exact selection/tie assertions; (2) OpenAPIClientMigrationTests — red-phase contract tests requiring a committed OpenAPI document at Sources/ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI/openapi.{yaml,yml,json} describing /api/v1/printer_profiles, /api/v1/colors?printer_profile_id, bearerAuth, and swift-openapi-generator/-runtime in Package.swift; (3) PaletteAPIClientTests wire-contract pins (request targets, query spelling, Accept header, envelope mapping) that must stay green through the generated-client migration, alongside the existing ProfileColorCacheTests offline/caching suite; (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md documenting corpus location, schema, refresh steps, and the OpenAPI document contract. BLOCKER: no Swift toolchain exists in this container (swift/swiftc/xcodebuild absent; no apt candidate; 1GB tmpfs too small for a toolchain), so swift test could not be executed — all runtime verification is recorded not_run. As semantic validation, an equivalent reimplementation of the replay harness verified all 12 corpus scenarios reproduce upstream expected scores, selections, tie indices, and tie_broke flags exactly (see summary; script not committed). Expected state at this head: 3 OpenAPI migration tests fail (deliverable not yet implemented — intended red), corpus + wire-pin tests expected green.
